component: Lockscreen touch recovery banner, battery flicker guard and software-render performance fix
note: Live userspace delta: lockscreen battery/touch handling, status-bar battery guard, real API battery fallback, and removal of alpha filters that forced continuous llvmpipe rasterisation. No kernel, partition, modem, DTB or USB gadget mutation.
invariants: No write may resolve onto a raw partition block device, a BOOT/USERDATA/SYSTEM/RECOVERY/DTB/DTBO/VBMETA image, the radio/modem, EFS/SEC_EFS/calibration/IMEI/PIT or any partition metadata.
Every deploy target must live under an allowed userspace root (assert_userspace_path).
Stage -> verify SHA-256 -> atomic install -> restart the smallest affected service -> health check -> automatic rollback on failure.
Sources must resolve INSIDE this repository (no absolute path, no '..').

groups.component: Lockscreen touch warning, battery guard, wider unlock band and filter-free idle rendering
groups.health_check: test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html)" = 200 && grep -q 'css/lockscreen.css?v=a82' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html && grep -q 'js/lockscreen.js?v=a82' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html && grep -q 'js/status-bar.js?v=a82' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html && grep -q 'lockscreen-touch-warning' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/index.html && grep -q 'v50-a82-lock-battery-perf' /usr/share/nuxel/pwa/nuxel-home/sw.js && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-wayland

groups.component: Bridge phone-status battery fallback and Full-vs-Charging truth
groups.health_check: systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-http-bridge && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/ping >/dev/null && python3 -m py_compile /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-bridge/api.py && grep -q 'status_text' /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-bridge/api.py
